subject.title: fix(signal): restore native replies for Signal sends

question: Should delivery-confirmed reservation become the canonical cross-channel contract for implicit single-use replies, rather than limiting this PR to Signal-owned quote durability?
rationale: The Signal bug is valid, but the proposed fix intentionally changes when shared reply state is consumed across streaming, tools, queues, CLI/MCP, and plugin-facing APIs; repository history cannot determine that lasting contract scope without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt Shared Transaction
options.body: Integrate the delivery-confirmed reservation contract onto current main and prove Signal plus representative sibling-channel behavior on the exact resolved head.

options.title: Limit To Signal
options.body: Keep durable Signal quote context but retain the existing shared planning-time reply-consumption contract.

options.title: Pause For Redesign
options.body: Hold the PR until a smaller owner-approved shared state-machine change and live Signal proof are available.

recommendation.title: Adopt Shared Transaction
recommendation.body: Integrate the delivery-confirmed reservation contract onto current main and prove Signal plus representative sibling-channel behavior on the exact resolved head.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared reply-reference behavior traces to steipete's prior work, and the affected files show the strongest historical contribution concentration there.
